patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Daughter) He spiked a high fever, he's burning up and shaking, and he's barely making sense — so weak he can't stand. He's been complaining his urine burns for days.
clinical.presentationShort: 79yo M ? fever 39.6?C, rigors, dysuria, confusion, profound weakness, HR 128 and BP 84/50.
clinical.presentationLong: 79-year-old male with several days of painful urination, now febrile with shaking chills, confusion, and weakness so severe he cannot stand. Heart rate is 128 and blood pressure is 84/50.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → sepsis bundle: cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour, 30 mL/kg fluids, lactate, source control; monitor.
diagnosis.why: Sepsis is a vitals diagnosis: fever, fast heart, low pressure. Antibiotics + fluids in the first hour save lives.
diagnosis.redFlag: Fever + hypotension + tachycardia + altered = septic shock; the vitals are screaming.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 79-year-old man, flushed and sweaty, looks very ill
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped, being propped up, barely holding his head up
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 79-year-old man, flushed and sweaty and clearly very ill, slumped on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped and propped up, barely holding his head up. Expression: glassy, exhausted, and unwell. Clearly visible: a flushed sweaty face and a weak, slumped posture. No text, no logos.
